Nice to meet you.

I have been looking at omu's illustrations for a long time, especially the "Cha Cha" and "Guru Guru" related illustrations on your sub-account, and I really like the way they remind me of the original works of the time.

So, my main question is, I would like to ask you to draw what is called "my child" in the style of omu-sama's illustrations.


Below is the profile of my "my child".

Profile
Name︰Chicutis
Age︰12 years old
Gender︰female
Character︰Sweet and gentle
Remarks︰She is a witch with black hair.
She wears black everyday clothes and white summer clothes.


My child" is a witch child and I was influenced by "Cha Cha" and "Guru Guru" in the past.

The composition of the full body, bust-up, etc. is left up to the artist's discretion.
I would appreciate it if you could draw her in your own style in a cute way.

Please refer to the URL for the clothing and other materials.
You may choose either black or white clothing.

Thank you in advance for your cooperation.
